title: Auditory and Visual Rhythm Omission EEG
description: This EEG dataset comprises recordings from 18 participants exposed to auditory and visual rhythmic stimuli with occasional omissions, designed to isolate predictive neural mechanisms from sensory-evoked activity. The study employs an omission paradigm to dissociate predictive processing in rhythm perception across modalities. Preprocessing code, time-frequency analysis, frequency band extraction, and statistical procedures are provided, with cluster analysis performed using EEGLAB.
methods_description: EEG recordings were obtained while 18 participants listened to auditory rhythms and viewed visual flashing rhythms in separate conditions. Both stimulus trains contained occasional omissions. Preprocessing, time-frequency computation, frequency band extraction, and statistical analysis were performed using custom code and EEGLAB Study functions for cluster formation.
